name: 华住会
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=华住会
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = appapi.huazhu.com, hweb-hotel.huazhu.com, hweb-manager.huazhu.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/appapi\.huazhu\.com:\d+\/client\/app\/getAppStartPage\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hweb-hotel\.huazhu\.com\/home\/queryRecommond/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hweb-hotel\.huazhu\.com\/{1,2}home\/(?>queryNewNotice|querySelectHotel|queryHotelBrand|queryMall|huazhuWorld)/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hweb-manager\.huazhu\.com\/notice\/getAppPopupNotifyAlert/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hweb-manager\.huazhu\.com\/bundle\/upgrade\/check/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hweb-manager\.huazhu\.com\/hotels\/ad\//i then reject_dict(200)
